tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search open vacancies in Cyprus on CyprusJobs.eu by words, town, field, minimum monthly pay, accommodation and language. Returns up to 20 vacancies with pay, town, employer and the link to apply. Applying is free; never pay anyone to get a job.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Full details of one vacancy on CyprusJobs.eu: duties, requirements, pay, town, type of work, languages, accommodation and how to apply. Pass the vacancy id or its CyprusJobs.eu link.

tools.name: job_market_overview
tools.description: How many vacancies are open on CyprusJobs.eu now, by town and by field, how many arrived in the last 7 days, and typical monthly pay from vacancies that state it.

tools.name: net_salary_cyprus
tools.description: Take-home pay in Cyprus under the 2026 rules (social insurance 8.8%, GESY 2.65%, income tax bands from €22,000) for a gross monthly salary, with 12 or 13 salaries a year. An estimate for a tax-resident employee, not tax advice.

tools.name: salary_insights
tools.description: What open vacancies in Cyprus pay now, from CyprusJobs.eu vacancies that state monthly pay: median, low and high for a job title, field or town, split by town and by field, with the number of vacancies behind each figure. Needs an API key (free during our launch): https://cyprusjobs.eu/developers.

tools.name: vacancy_feed
tools.description: Full vacancies that employers posted on CyprusJobs.eu themselves (not copied from other sites), newest first, with description, pay, town and the link to apply; page through with offset.
